type github.com/ronhuafeng/llm-go/llmkit/llmstep.Attempt[O any] struct{Iteration int; Repair []github.com/ronhuafeng/llm-go/llmkit/llmstep.Repair; Call github.com/ronhuafeng/llm-go/llmkit/llmadapter.ValueResult[O]; Judgment *github.com/ronhuafeng/llm-go/llmkit/llmstep.Judgment; NextRepair []github.com/ronhuafeng/llm-go/llmkit/llmstep.Repair; Err error}
type github.com/ronhuafeng/llm-go/llmkit/llmstep.Finding struct{Summary string `json:"summary,omitempty"`; Codes []string `json:"codes,omitempty"`; Locations []string `json:"locations,omitempty"`}
type github.com/ronhuafeng/llm-go/llmkit/llmstep.Judgment struct{Accepted bool `json:"accepted"`; Findings []github.com/ronhuafeng/llm-go/llmkit/llmstep.Finding `json:"findings,omitempty"`}
type github.com/ronhuafeng/llm-go/llmkit/llmstep.Repair struct{Iteration int `json:"iteration,omitempty"`; Summary string `json:"summary,omitempty"`; Codes []string `json:"codes,omitempty"`; Locations []string `json:"locations,omitempty"`}

type github.com/ronhuafeng/llm-go/llmkit/llmstep.Result[O any] struct{Output O; HasOutput bool; Attempts []github.com/ronhuafeng/llm-go/llmkit/llmstep.Attempt[O]}
type github.com/ronhuafeng/llm-go/llmkit/llmstep.Stage string
type github.com/ronhuafeng/llm-go/llmkit/llmstep.StepError struct{Stage github.com/ronhuafeng/llm-go/llmkit/llmstep.Stage; Iteration int; Err error}
type github.com/ronhuafeng/llm-go/llmkit/llmstep.Step[I any, O any] struct{Caller github.com/ronhuafeng/llm-go/llmkit/llmadapter.Caller; Render func(context.Context, I, []github.com/ronhuafeng/llm-go/llmkit/llmstep.Repair) (string, error); Validate func(context.Context, I, O) (github.com/ronhuafeng/llm-go/llmkit/llmstep.Judgment, error); MaxIter int; Sanitizer github.com/ronhuafeng/llm-go/llmkit/llmstep.RepairSanitizer}
